the most important factors in explaining customer‐related performance are: (i) market orientation, (ii) customer‐relationship management, and (iii) Internet banking applications and Web‐site quality.
Internet banking is a powerful tool in relationship‐marketing efforts, but it is not the only one.
Internet banking has a strong impact on customer loyalty and that the impact is stronger the more advanced Internet technology is used and the more attractive and user‐oriented the Web site is.

the role Internet banking can play in relationship marketing, and we conclude that the Internet is not a panacea but a useful supplement to traditional marketing efforts.
